1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing or using 69Shop.in (the "Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you do not agree to these Terms, you must not use the Platform. These Terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and 69Shop.in, operated under the laws of India.

2. Eligibility

To use the Platform, you must:

  • Be at least 18 years of age or have parental/guardian consent
  • Be capable of forming a legally binding contract under Indian law
  • Not be barred from using the Platform under any applicable law
  • Provide accurate and complete registration information

3. User Accounts

When you create an account on the Platform:

  • You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials
  • You are responsible for all activities that occur under your account
  • You must immediately notify us of any unauthorized use of your account at support@69shop.in

Authentication is managed through Firebase Authentication. Passwords are never stored in plaintext and are handled by Google's security infrastructure.

4. Marketplace Services

69Shop.in is a multi-vendor marketplace that connects buyers with independent sellers. We provide:

  • Product listings created by verified sellers
  • Secure checkout with multiple payment options
  • Order management including tracking and delivery coordination
  • Communication tools for buyer-seller messaging
  • Service booking for local service providers

69Shop.in acts as an intermediary platform. We do not own, manufacture, store, or ship the products listed by sellers. Each seller is independently responsible for their product quality, descriptions, pricing, and fulfilment.

5. Orders and Payments

Pricing: All prices are listed in Indian Rupees (INR) and are inclusive of applicable taxes unless stated otherwise. Sellers set their own prices.

Payment Methods: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD) and online payments through Razorpay (UPI, debit/credit cards, net banking) once payment gateway integration is fully active.

Order Confirmation: An order is confirmed only after successful payment processing or acceptance of COD terms. We reserve the right to cancel orders due to pricing errors, stock unavailability, or suspected fraudulent activity.

Cancellation: Orders may be cancelled before shipment. Once shipped, the return/refund policy applies. See our Returns & Refund Policy for details.

6. Seller Terms

Sellers on 69Shop.in must:

  • Complete KYC verification (PAN, GST, bank account details) before listing products
  • Provide accurate product descriptions, images, and pricing
  • Fulfil orders within the committed timeframe (1-2 business days processing)
  • Comply with all applicable Indian laws and regulations including the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020
  • Maintain product quality standards and respond to customer queries promptly

69Shop.in charges a category-based commission on each sale (5%-15%). Commission details are provided in the seller dashboard and the Seller Agreement.
